cards.example_en: She lost control of the kite when a sudden gust hit the field.
cards.example_zh: 突然一阵风刮过场地，她控制不住风筝了。

cards.example_en: The couple in front of us shared headphones on the train.
cards.example_zh: 我们前面的那一对在火车上合用一副耳机。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：炸土豆片
cards.example_en: We split a bag of crisps on the bench after football practice.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练结束后，我们在长椅上分了一袋炸土豆片。

cards.example_en: This cup has a crack, so the tea leaks onto the saucer.
cards.example_zh: 这个杯子有裂缝，茶水漏到了碟子上。

cards.example_en: His desire to make the team kept him running before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 他想进队的欲望让他早饭前坚持跑步。

cards.example_en: The nurse suggested a diet with more vegetables and less fried food.
cards.example_zh: 护士建议饮食里多吃蔬菜，少吃油炸食品。

cards.example_en: The potato dish from the canteen sold out before noon.
cards.example_zh: 食堂的土豆菜肴中午之前就卖完了。

cards.example_en: A cold drink from the machine cost more than my bus fare.
cards.example_zh: 自动售货机里的一杯冷饮比我的车费还贵。

cards.example_en: The drug eased my sore throat, but it made me sleepy in class.
cards.example_zh: 这种药物缓解了嗓子疼，却让我上课发困。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：吃；进食
cards.example_en: We eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
cards.example_zh: 除夕晚上我们一起吃饺子。

cards.example_en: I dropped an egg on the floor and had to clean it before class.
cards.example_zh: 我把一个鸡蛋掉在地上，上课前只好收拾干净。

cards.example_en: The shop will employ two new workers.
cards.example_zh: 这家商店将雇用两名新员工。

cards.example_en: I recorded the last episode so I could watch it after training.
cards.example_zh: 我把最后一集录了下来，好在训练结束后看。

cards.example_en: The hamster tried to escape from its small cage.
cards.example_zh: 那只仓鼠试图从自己的小笼子里逃走。

cards.example_en: I burned my finger while frying eggs this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上煎鸡蛋时，我烫伤了手指。
